ShortDescription.Value: Change zoning on the sides of roads: Left/Right/Both/None. Flip with RMB, apply with LMB.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Easy Zoning [EZ] Beta
Custom zoning for new and existing roads; includes Contour on/off toggle.
## Features
- **Right-Click** flips preview (Left↔Right or Both↔None) - Small vanilla-style “Zone Change” panel beside Roads - Show Contour Topography toggle (on/off) - Hover to Preview and remembers your last selection - Options to protect existing buildings and already-zoned grids - Launch: Top-left icon or **Ctrl + Z** hotkey
## How to use
**New Road:** open game **Roads** panel → select the **Zoning** icon desired, draw roads as usual.
**Existing Road:** 1. Open EZ panel > use Top Left icon or Ctrl+Z keybind. 2. Select the Zone icon (see image) > Hover a road to preview. 3. **Right-Click** to switch sides; **Left-Click** to apply. 4. Bonus: moving the mouse a little to the left or right of the road will also flip the side. 5. Show Contour terrain lines even if you do not need to update zoning.
## Compatibility - Remove Zone Tools or ART mod to avoid conflicts. - No Harmony, extends vanilla UI (helps it be more stable on game patch days and increases compatibility). - Uses native game inputs and sounds. - Safe to remove any time. Road you zoned will keep their zoning. - Should work with Platter mod. - Lightweight, optimized, runs only when needed.
## Support and feedback - If mod helps you, give it a Like, it's free + easy :) - Feedback to GitHub, Discord, or forum links on this page.
## Tech notes
- At certain diagonal angles, one-sided zoning left or right (↖||↗) may be assigned to the other side than you expect (just swap it). Reason: newly drawn roads, the zoning side ←|→ is relative to the road segment’s internal orientation.
